public_source_basis.research_claim: Using weekly CFTC CME Bitcoin derivatives data, asset managers' option positions selectively predict the second-week-ahead weekly futures return.
official_claims: TFF futures-only and futures-and-options-combined annual files are public
combined option positions are futures-equivalent and COT reports are normally released Friday 15:30 ET

mechanism.claim: A week-over-week increase in CME BTC asset-manager net option exposure represents new institutional directional convexity demand. Follow that change only during an already high-variation BTC state in the causally available second week after the CFTC report.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the week-over-week change in isolated asset-manager option net = delta[(combined long-short)-(futures-only long-short)]
mechanism.why_distinct: This is an external weekly regulatory-position clock. It uses neither Binance/Deribit positioning, funding, premium, OI, CFTC enforcement events, BTC trend direction, prior event rows, fitted outcomes, nor prior controls. The two-week conservative availability/forecast alignment and seven-day hold are absent from Gross9.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: entry requires prior-24h BTC realized variation in its causal upper 40%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: at most one Tuesday 00:05 UTC institutional-position trade per week

features.contract: CFTC TFF CME BITCOIN contract, identical market code in futures-only and futures+options combined files
features.position_change: current isolated option net minus immediately prior report's value; exact consecutive report dates seven calendar days apart; strict nonzero
features.conservative_availability: report_date+7 calendar days 00:00 UTC, later than the normal Friday release and robust to ordinary holiday delay
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed BTCUSDT 5m close/open log returns over [entry-24h,entry)); strict-prior daily-boundary midrank over 270 states, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.60

clock.decision: report_date+14 calendar days 00:00 UTC after CFTC report and prior-day BTC path are available
clock.reservation: weekly half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 audit only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.btc: hash-bound completed 5m cache plus read-only Postgres extension through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no position field, sign, threshold, lag, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair.
